object.customQuery:
select id, (Select id, opportunityid,opportunity.Services_Entity__c,
opportunity.Reseller__c,
opportunity.CurrencyISOCode,
opportunity.Billing_Terms__c,
opportunity.PO_Number__c,
opportunity.PO_Status__c,
opportunity.OS_Order_Number__c,
opportunity.Name,
opportunity.Contract_Date__c,
opportunity.Type,
opportunity.Transacted_On_Marketplace__c,
opportunity.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.Supersede_OS__c,
opportunity.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.SBQQ__BillingStreet__c,
opportunity.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.SBQQ__BillingCity__c,
opportunity.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.SBQQ__BillingState__c,
opportunity.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.SBQQ__BillingPostalCode__c,
opportunity.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.SBQQ__BillingCountry__c,
opportunity.SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.Print_Layout__c from SBQQ__OpportunityProducts__r)  from SBQQ__QuoteLine__c where id in (select Quote_Line__c from Billing_Schedule_Line_Item__c where Billing_Schedule__r.Workday_Sync_Status__c = 'Ready for Sync' )

fields.name: v_Invoice_Type
fields.expression:
iif (not(isnull(Transacted_on_Marketplace__c)) and Transacted_on_Marketplace__c <> '' , 'Marketplace',
iif (Print_Layout__c = 'Summary Pricing Only', 'Partially_Suppressed' ,
iif (PO_Status__c = 'Full PO' or PO_Status__c = 'POEF Signed', 'Auto_Approve_Subscription' ,
'Standard')))

object.customQuery:
SELECT 
Id,Amount__c,Quote_Line__c,Start_Date__c,End_date__c,
Billing_Schedule__r.id,
Billing_Schedule__r.Billing_Amount__c,
Billing_Schedule__r.Billing_Date__c,
Billing_Schedule__r.Billing_Period_End_Date__c,
Billing_Schedule__r.Billing_Period_Start_Date__c,
Billing_Schedule__r.CurrencyIsoCode,
Billing_Schedule__r.Quote__c,
Billing_Schedule__r.Schedule_Type__c
 FROM Billing_Schedule_Line_Item__c 
where Billing_Schedule__r.Workday_Sync_Status__c = 'Ready for Sync'
order by Quote_Line__c,Start_Date__c

fields.name: v_amount
fields.expression:
iif (( v_prev_key <> v_curr_key  or isnull(v_prev_key) ) and Src_CurrencyIsoCode = 'JPY' and 
to_integer(substr(to_char(BS_Amount__c),INSTR( to_char(BS_Amount__c), '.'  ) + 1)) * 100000 > 0 , to_char(floor(BS_Amount__c) + 1), 
iif (Src_CurrencyIsoCode = 'JPY',to_char(floor(BS_Amount__c)),
to_char(BS_Amount__c)))
